design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the administrator asks only to close the practice's Northgate+ Business membership today with a refund. The Business closure rule waits on three ledger states (an earning for every fulfilled earning line; a reversal for every return, and for every damaged/never-received refund without return, when the line's earning differs from its kept-units basis). The agent must find the uncollected printer earning (posted during the payment hold, so at the Rewards rate), the monitor return and the coffee-maker refund, compute each with its schedules, and only then compute the refund, whose Business Cash recovery depends on all three.
SCOPE: task 1 claims membership_ext_business_cash_earning, membership_ext_business_return_reversal, membership_ext_unreturned_refund_reversal, membership_ext_business_closure_refund and tools post_business_cash_earning_affdfb03, reverse_business_return_cash_4d4108b5, reverse_unreturned_refund_cash_522719bc, confirm_business_membership_closure_a0a2c96c. Task 0 holds the consumer earning, consumer return reversal and annual cancellation refund; scopes are disjoint by tier family (record test on the membership tier) and by refund kind (return vs refund without return).
DRAW: prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6,5,6,6] -> earning 6, return reversal 6, refund-without-return reversal 5, closure refund 6.
PROBLEM TREE: root membership_ext_business_closure_refund (owner=user). Edges (all value_input, gate business_rate_cash, state form): (1) affirmative 'The Business refund is worked out only after the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first has its Northgate Cash earning on the membership's ledger, when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date, the Northgate Cash earned on the membership in the twelve whole calendar months before today is below the tier's annual Northgate Cash limit and the line's earning under the Business earning schedule comes to at least one cent.' false: printer line fb2290bf-e603-4a22-a041-9e7ba693b10c has no earning; (2) negated 'The Business refund is not worked out until the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first carries its reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.' false: return cc520a87-21ce-43a5-8f59-70ae4375ee75 against earning f7021f02-04a5-475f-802c-bb16497210e1 (basis = the full line net, which differs from the line's kept-units basis) has no reversal; (3) 'Before the Business refund is worked out, the most recent refund without a return made because an item was damaged on arrival or never received on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest refund date and, among refunds of one kind on that date, the one recorded first, and when a damaged-on-arrival refund and a never-received refund share that date, the damaged-on-arrival refund must carry its reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.' false: refund c7793dee-aaf6-4ec7-8e56-957e6e2bfaa7 against earning 683f8c9a-4bf0-4c65-8669-0af30f59189e (basis = full line net, differs from the kept-units basis) has none. Each owed-reversal test is stated word for word in its reversal rule. The printer's own damaged-unit refund is not the selected refund and its earning will be posted on the kept units. Order earning -> return reversal -> refund reversal -> refund; the three prerequisites commute. Deletion sensitivity: skip earning 39.02, skip return reversal 32.49, skip refund reversal 33.50, gold 34.58.
FACTOR CARD earning 9.31 (baseline 13.54): payment_hold_rate (hold 2026-05-15, two declines, settled 2026-05-20, collected 2026-05-18 -> 1.0; multi-source) 12.69; volume_points (12-month lines 4342.83 -> +0.25, order) 8.46; business_card_points (Business Mastercard active -> +0.5; card) 7.62; business_kept_units (677.06 x (2 - 1) / 2 units kept = 338.53) 18.62; pickup_points (Order Pickup +0.5) 7.62; business_tenure_points (24 months +0.5) 7.62. Near-miss: the returned Keurig order and the placed wipes order are later by order date but not in fulfilled status.
FACTOR CARD return reversal 5.30 (baseline 8.20): business_closing_share (1 of 4, price-matched -> unit share 8.8275) 4.92; reason defective 0.10 -> 6.18; tenure 23 months 0.05 -> 5.74; only return in 12 months 0.10 -> 6.18; volume 0.05 -> 5.74; bulk 4-unit line 0.10 -> 6.18.
FACTOR CARD refund reversal 3.13 (baseline 4.67): unreturned_closing_share (whole unit, price drop made the refund 169.99 < 189.99) 2.80; damaged 0.20 -> 4.18; tenure 24 months 0.10 -> 3.65; two refunds without return in 12 months 0.05 -> 3.39; volume 0.05 -> 3.39. Near-miss: the printer refund (2026-05-18) is the earlier damaged refund and is not the one settled.
FACTOR CARD closure refund 34.58 (baseline 10.11): business_money_back (14 days, use 2026-05-29 -> 92.01; multi-source) 32.40; volume_recovery_share 0.75 -> 14.65; hold_day_credit (two declines, 5 days -> 1.3425) 33.24; business_cardholder_courtesy (Business Mastercard -> 2.0417; card) 32.54; benefit_usage_withholding (5 uses -> 2.0417 taken) 36.62; loyalty_credit (3 fees -> 1.0208) 33.56.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: immediate_from_active (status active); full_refund_window anchored on the 2026-05-20 settlement (event_date) +30 days inclusive -> last day 2026-06-19, 2026-06-03 qualifies; refund_once (no refund row); reverse_once_per_return for both reversals (no reversal rows). The 2026 fee settled inside the 14-day grace (2026-05-15 + 14 = 2026-05-29); renewal_date counted from the declined period start (2027-05-15).
SEED: business customer (WI), Business Mastercard (balance residue: card events are not read), Northgate+ Business since 2024-05-01, 15 membership ledger rows, 7 orders, 18 order rows priced with the order and card charters (3% Business card discount half up per line, Ship to Home threshold ties recorded as benefit uses, price match/drop within 14 days and net of the card discount, electronics 30-day return window with no Business card extension, Order Pickup 2-day missing-item report). No automatic clause fires before 2026-06-03 (next renewal 2027-05-15; earliest Cash expiry 2026-07-11).
PERSONA: hurried dental-practice owner; volunteers only the goal; facts about the late renewal, returns and refunds only on request; agrees to Cash corrections after explanation; runs the closure tool; never states a figure.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate/verify -> membership -> ledger -> orders -> order ledger -> card; post 9.31; reverse 5.30; reverse 3.13; hand over the closure with 34.58, basis full_within_window, against the 2026-05-20 fee. check_compute --task 1 reproduces every figure above at handling time (COMPUTE OK).
user_scenario:
You are Gregory Castellano, the office administrator and owner of Castellano Family Dental in Madison, Wisconsin. You are calling Northgate customer care between patients, so you are friendly but in a hurry and you like plain answers. The practice has decided to buy its supplies through a dental distributor from now on, so you want the practice's Northgate+ Business membership closed right away, today, and you would like the renewal fee you paid last month refunded. You open with exactly that: you want to close the Northgate+ Business membership today and get a refund of this year's fee. If the agent suggests letting the membership run to its renewal date instead, you say no, close it now with whatever refund applies.
You give details only when asked: your mobile number is 6085550163, your date of birth is 1959-08-03 (August 3, 1959), the business is Castellano Family Dental, your email is gregory@castellanofamilydental.com and the billing ZIP code is 53703. You do not remember any order or reference numbers and you let the agent look things up.
Only if the agent asks about recent orders or why the renewal came through late do you mention, as plain facts: the renewal was declined on your old card in May, so you put a new card on the account on May 20 and the fee went through then; one of the four monitors was returned at the store on May 12 because it was defective; the office coffee maker arrived damaged and was refunded on May 25; and one of the two printers you picked up on May 18 was damaged and refunded at the counter. If asked where the refund should go, you say back to the card that paid the fee.
If the agent explains that some Northgate Cash entries have to be posted or corrected on the account first, or asks to put the account records in order, you say that is fine, go ahead. You do not know how the Cash or the refund is calculated and you never offer a figure; if the agent tells you an amount you just say you understand and ask to finish.
When the agent hands you the closure confirmation, you run it yourself with the details the agent gives you. Once it shows the membership is closed and the refund booked, you thank the agent and hang up. If the agent says it is closed without handing you anything to confirm, you thank them and hang up as well.

edges.condition: The line recorded first on the member's order with the latest fulfilled date among orders in fulfilled status (ties: the order recorded first), when that line earns (its category is not excluded, the membership was not canceled on the fulfilled date, twelve-month membership_cash_earn total below rewards_annual_earn_cap_usd and the line's Business-schedule earning at least 0.01), has a membership_cash_earn row whose source_order_event_id is that line.
edges.policy_source: The Business refund is worked out only after the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first has its Northgate Cash earning on the membership's ledger, when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date, the Northgate Cash earned on the membership in the twelve whole calendar months before today is below the tier's annual Northgate Cash limit and the line's earning under the Business earning schedule comes to at least one cent.

edges.condition: The latest order_return_line row on the member's orders (ties: recorded first) has a membership_cash_reverse row whose source_order_event_id is that return, when the line's membership_cash_earn basis_amount_usd differs from RND(line amount_usd x (line quantity - quantity of order_refund_charge rows on the line) / line quantity, 2) - the amount_usd of order_return_line rows on the line.
edges.policy_source: The Business refund is not worked out until the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first carries its reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.

edges.policy_source: Before the Business refund is worked out, the most recent refund without a return made because an item was damaged on arrival or never received on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest refund date and, among refunds of one kind on that date, the one recorded first, and when a damaged-on-arrival refund and a never-received refund share that date, the damaged-on-arrival refund must carry its reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.
